# How can one physics controller accept full trajectories, VR head/hands, arbitrary joint keyframes, and text?

> **Current answer:** MaskedMimic first trains a physics tracker with complete future goals, then uses DAgger, structured random masking, and a conditional VAE to unify multiple inputs as an explicit partial-goal inpainting interface. It covers only trained mask/condition distributions and does not automatically solve conflicting goals, long-horizon planning, sensor bias, or real-robot deployment.

## Key terms

- Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE, 条件变分自编码器)
- Dataset Aggregation (DAgger, 数据聚合)
- Motion Inpainting (动作补全)
- Structured Masking (结构化遮罩)

## Applicable robots

- Simulated humanoid characters in the paper; real robots require separate dynamics and safety evidence

## Applicable simulators

- ProtoMotions-supported simulation with matched scene, mask, and observation contracts

## Controllers and methods

- Fully constrained motion tracker
- DAgger-distilled conditional-VAE partial-goal controller

## Applicable environments

- Simulated full-body, VR, keyframe, text, terrain, and object-conditioned character control

## Assumptions

- A fully constrained teacher can track the source motion distribution.
- Deployment command/missingness patterns are represented by the versioned structured-mask distribution.

## Diagnosis and verification

- First verify the applicable robot, simulator, controller, environment, and assumptions, then follow the evidence locators below to inspect the original experiment or implementation.

## Result

- MaskedMimic first trains a physics tracker with complete future goals, then uses DAgger, structured random masking, and a conditional VAE to unify multiple inputs as an explicit partial-goal inpainting interface. It covers only trained mask/condition distributions and does not automatically solve conflicting goals, long-horizon planning, sensor bias, or real-robot deployment.

## Limitations

- A fully constrained teacher can track the source motion distribution.
- Deployment command/missingness patterns are represented by the versioned structured-mask distribution.

## Safety notes

- This page is an evidence guide, not an executable hardware-control instruction. Hardware work still requires simulation validation, limits, protective equipment, and human review.
